final.title: Reminder to file 2025 tax return
steps: Complete and sign your 2025 tax return using the paper form or online via ZHPrivateTax.
Include your 2025 salary certificates from all employers and your list of securities and assets (including foreign accounts as of the end of the tax period).
Submit the complete 2025 tax return and all required documents by January 7, 2027 (the postmark date counts; no further extension will be granted).
final.objection: An estimated tax assessment can only be appealed on the grounds of obvious inaccuracy.
final.if_ignored: If you do not submit your tax return, the tax office will estimate your taxes at its own discretion, and you will be fined up to CHF 1,000 (or up to CHF 10,000 in serious cases).

final.title: Overpayment notice for unemployment benefits
steps: Pay 2 860,32 € by January 8, 2027, either by bank transfer to IBAN FR76 3000 1007 9412 3456 7890 185 (account holder compte : France Travail Occitanie, recouvrement des France Travail Occitanie, recouvrement des indus) with the mandatory reference TP-2026-31-0072581, or by check payable to France Travail Occitanie, recouvrement des indus with TP-2026-31-0072581 written on the back, sent to France Travail Occitanie, Service recouvrement, TSA 40112, 31046 Toulouse Cedex 9.

Or, if you want a payment plan (6 monthly payments of 476,72 € or 12 monthly payments of 238,36 €, starting January 8, 2027), request it before December 31, 2026 by writing to your advisor from your personal account (francetravail.fr) and include proof of your income.
final.objection: You can contest this decision within two months of notification by filing a prior appeal with the branch director (if no reply within two months, it is deemed rejected), and then appeal to the Toulouse judicial court within two months of the reply. You can also ask the regional joint committee (instance paritaire régionale) for a full or partial debt waiver if your financial situation justifies it, or contact the regional mediator via your personal account.
final.if_ignored: If you do not pay or agree on a payment plan by the deadline, France Travail Occitanie, recouvrement des indus can issue an enforcement order (contrainte) with the effect of a court judgment, and then seize your wages or bank account. If you receive new benefits, the debt may also be deducted from future payments up to the seizable limit. Intentional failure to declare can lead to an administrative penalty and removal from the jobseekers' list.

read as "instance bipartite régionale", understood as "instance paritaire régionale" (regional joint committee)
read as "de nouveaux allocations", understood as "de nouveau des allocations" (benefits again)

explained.title: Overpayment refund notice for unemployment benefits
steps: Pay the amount of 2 860,32 € by bank transfer using IBAN FR76 3000 1007 9412 3456 7890 185, making sure to include the mandatory reference TP-2026-31-0072581 in the transfer description.

Alternatively, pay by check made out to France Travail Occitanie, recouvrement des indus with the overpayment reference on the back, sent to the address: France Travail Occitanie, Service recouvrement, TSA 40112, 31046 Toulouse Cedex 9.
To request a payment plan or debt waiver, write to your advisor through your personal space before December 31, 2026.
explained.if_ignored: If you do not pay or reach an agreement by the deadline, France Travail may issue a formal constraint with the effect of a judgment, and start seizing your salary or bank account. Intentional omission of declarations can also lead to an administrative penalty and removal from the job seeker list.
